The '''Independent Slavers Space Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]]. It was used by [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] not related to the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] who organized the largest slavery operations in the system with the support of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. With the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|conquest of Kashyyyk]], numerous independent interests arrived on Kashyyyk, looking to take their piece of a growing business.
